title: Hisense U75 (device hengshan, MediaTek), Google TV / Android 12, build STT2.230310.002.
header:
Hisense U75 (device hengshan, MediaTek), Google TV / Android 12, build STT2.230310.002.
Android model string is "SmartTV 4K FFM" (same string as the Android 10 huangshan set, but a
different device and a mostly different package namespace: com.vt.* here, com.hisense.* there).
2.4 GB RAM. Latin America / Brazil market (Ginga broadcast middleware preloaded).

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/hisense-u75-hengshan/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/hisense-u75-hengshan/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

WARNING: do not add com.vt.tv.smartsense, com.vt.tv.smartsense.ui, com.vt.tv.ai_sense,
com.vt.tv.aiot, com.vt.tv.aiotprotocolapp or com.vt.tv.aiotsystemservice. On the related
huangshan firmware disabling that family sent the TV to Android Recovery on the next boot
("Can't load Android system"). "Try again" booted normally and restore.sh undid it. If you ever
land on that screen, pick "Try again", never "Factory data reset".

Keep, verified load-bearing on this set:
com.vt.tv.tvcenter        Live TV app (LiveTV)
com.vt.tv.input           the Inputs / source menu
com.vt.source.external    HDMI inputs      com.vt.source.tuner   tuner input
com.mediatek.dtv.tvinput.framework.server  TV input framework
com.vt.tv.commonui, com.vt.tvservice, com.vt.avmiddleware, com.vt.tvplayer, com.vt.edv.drmp
com.mediatek.autopair     remote pairing   com.mediatek.android.tv.globalkeyoverlay  remote keys
com.google.android.tv.remote.service       com.google.android.inputmethod.latin  keyboard
com.android.vending, com.google.android.gms, com.google.android.gsf, com.android.tv.settings
com.vt.tv.smartservice, com.dolby.android.audio.service, com.vt.tv.aipq, com.vt.tv.videocolor
com.vt.eula               wired to ota.eula.message, keep it while OTA is kept
com.vt.udpserver          LAN discovery used by casting / the phone remote
Already disabled at the factory: com.mediatek.tis, com.mediatek.dtv.tvinput.isdbtuner,
com.mediatek.dtv.tvinput.dvbtuner
Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (Google TV), handled by build-and-install.sh.

Google TV ad, preload and tracking services
Launcher phase only
sections.note: Google TV's setup wizard also claims android.intent.category.HOME (priority 1, RecoveryActivity), so it takes Home the moment the stock launcher is disabled and a third-party launcher can never own the Home button. Leave this line out if you are only debloating. On some sets the wizard holds the Wi-Fi credentials saved during setup; if the TV forgets its network, re-enter it with the remote. restore.sh re-enables it.
